integrity: All analytical claims are supported by the displayed VCG identity and integrals; checker.py reproduces exact finite-grid calculations and symbolic integral identities. Numerical tests are sanity checks, not continuous proofs.
scientific_limitations: Two unit-demand bidders and two goods with nonnegative values, no reserves and pivot payments only. The local distribution-free result assumes iid exchangeable bidder rows and atomless preference gaps; mean monotonicity additionally needs symmetric unimodal gap density, which is not claimed necessary. Continuous but bimodal gaps can reverse expected monotonicity. Finite shock polynomials assume four iid Uniform(0,1) initial entries and an untruncated additive shift. No extension to other market sizes, strategic manipulation, or independent proof audit.
title: Universal local VCG revenue fragility, unimodal mean monotonicity, and exact shock laws
